entries.resolvedMessage: On money it's a wash, so I left it for now — will revisit after a few more trips.

recommendation.verdict: Your rail usage sits right on the BahnCard 25 / BahnCard 50 break-even line
recommendation.summaryText: Your long-distance spend puts you almost exactly on the crossover between BahnCard 25 and BahnCard 50 — on cost alone the two are within a couple of euros a year. Because you book late and value flexibility, BahnCard 50 is the better fit, but it is close enough that keeping BahnCard 25 is defensible too.

metrics.label: Net cost difference — essentially a wash

reasoning: Your long-distance rail spend implies a full-price equivalent around €536/year — almost exactly the €532 point where BahnCard 50 starts to out-save BahnCard 25
At this level the two cards are within about €1–2/year of each other, so cost does not decide it
Your fares are flexible Flexpreis tickets: BahnCard 50 discounts those by 50% versus only 25% on BahnCard 25 — the extra card fee is almost entirely recovered by the deeper flex-fare discount
Time is your highest-weighted priority (0.50) and you value time over money, so the near-tie breaks toward the more flexible card
assumptions: Assumes your late-booking / flexible-fare pattern continues — if you switched to advance Sparpreis fares, BahnCard 25 would be the cleaner pick, since Sparpreis discounts are identical (25%) on both cards
CO2 impact is neutral — this only changes discount tier, not which transport mode you use

alternatives.name: Upgrade to BahnCard 50 (2. Klasse, Standard, Jahresabo)
alternatives.tradeoff: Costs about the same overall — the deeper Flexpreis discount offsets the higher card fee. You gain full-flex 50% fares, which protects your time when plans change.

action.title: Upgrade to BahnCard 50 (2. Klasse, Standard, Jahresabo)
action.description: Replace your BahnCard 25 with a BahnCard 50 before the 30 November 2026 renewal — it is cost-neutral at your usage and covers your flexible fares at 50%.
action.consequence: Your BahnCard 25 (2. Klasse, Standard, Jahresabo) will be cancelled and a BahnCard 50 (2. Klasse, Standard, Jahresabo) will start in its place.

alternatives.name: Keep BahnCard 25 (2. Klasse, Standard, Jahresabo)
alternatives.tradeoff: Defensible only if you shift to booking cheaper advance Sparpreis fares — you would lose the deeper flex discount that suits your last-minute style.

recommendation.verdict: Still a cost coin-flip — your preference for flexibility tips it to BahnCard 50
recommendation.summaryText: Another five months of trips confirm the picture: on price, BahnCard 25 and BahnCard 50 are a dead heat for you. What breaks the tie is that you book late and reschedule often — BahnCard 50's 50% flex-fare discount is worth more to you than the marginal saving of staying on BahnCard 25.
